paragraphs.text: Gamer is a creature type used for cards that depict people playing games, including Magic: The Gathering . All current known Gamers are Humans except for one, which is a Zombie .
Gamer was introduced in Unhinged and appeared in subsequent un-sets — Unstable , Unsanctioned , and Unfinity .
Unfinity made the class eternal legal with the introduction of The Most Dangerous Gamer .
